findings.trigger: After creating a checkpoint, change groups[0].intent while leaving its input fingerprint, source hashes and candidate IDs unchanged; resume the same request.
findings.expected: Reject the changed cached semantic description, or rebuild it from the original timed request.
findings.actual: The checkpoint source identity/timing checks pass and the changed intent text is returned.
findings.impact: A corrupted/edited local checkpoint can misdescribe verified source-backed alternatives. Source bytes, allowed paths, timing/level checks and full creator context remain independently checked. Checkpoints are not authenticated semantic receipts.
findings.status: Confirmed; left unfixed under final-review rule. Do not accept externally supplied checkpoints; suite should defer semantic checkpoint trust pending owner-approved follow-up.

findings.expected: A log boundary used for provider/tool requests should redact authentication fields.
findings.actual: Caller-supplied metadata is copied to receipts/sink unchanged. No real secret was used in this probe.
findings.impact: Raw provider headers/tool payloads must not be passed to this hook until a redaction boundary is implemented. Current fixture calls contain no credentials.
findings.status: Confirmed during final runtime audit; recorded, not fixed after final review.

findings.expected: A strict local-only configuration validator rejects cloud model suffixes on all input paths.

findings.impact: Configured defaults examined are local and no automatic cloud fallback was found, but explicit override validation is not a complete local-only enforcement boundary. Shared helper is outside this feature reservation.
findings.status: Confirmed validation-path issue; not evidence of an actual cloud call. Recorded, not repaired.
